name: Kaya's Alive
summary: Makaba Flathoof has word that Kaya Flathoof survived the Grimtotem attack in Stonetalon. He sends you to Sun Rock Retreat, where her aunt Tammra Windfield waits anxiously.

sections.title: A Breath of Relief
sections.body: The Grimtotem strike along Stonetalon's contested trails. When their village came under attack, young Kaya Flathoof was feared dead or taken by the renegades. Her rescue brings relief while tribes still fight among the crags.

sections.title: Reaching Sun Rock Retreat
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof sends you from Kaya to Sun Rock Retreat with news of her safety. Her aunt, Tammra Windfield, waits there anxiously for word from the trails. Your message comforts the family and keeps the remote Horde outpost connected.

faq.answer: Kaya Flathoof is a young tauren separated from her people when rogue Grimtotem forces attacked her settlement in Stonetalon Mountains.
Tammra Windfield is Kaya's aunt and lives at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon Mountains. She feared her niece had died in the Grimtotem attack.
Grimtotem forces attacked Kaya's village. This isolationist tauren faction preys on rival tribes and travelers across the mountains.
You have just helped Kaya Flathoof flee her captors and return to safety in 'Protect Kaya'.

faq.q: Where is Sun Rock Retreat located?
faq.answer: Sun Rock Retreat lies high in the central Stonetalon Mountains. Follow the main road west through a narrow mountain defile into a sheltered basin.

faq.q: Why does Makaba Flathoof send you instead of going himself?
faq.answer: Makaba remains at his camp near Stonetalon's southeastern edge. He sends you to carry news swiftly to his family at Sun Rock Retreat.

angles.text: In Stonetalon's contested wilderness, Horde forces are stretched thin. News that survivors are safe helps scattered encampments hold together.
As a tauren, you know the Grimtotem threat cuts into a painful rift among the Shu'halo. Keeping innocent family members like Kaya safe matters deeply.
